tagline: Professional beverage ingredients for HoReCa, cafés and menu-development teams.

story.title: Professional beverage ingredients for HoReCa, cafés and menu-development teams.
story.body: Health Today Indonesia says it has produced beverage ingredients since 2007 and serves more than 1,000 customers. The company supplies premium powder, syrup, fruit mix, tea, coffee, gourmet sauce, toppings and related beverage products, with its first factory in Taman Tekno, Tangerang Selatan and an R&D/microbiology lab.
